answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the relic of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure. Work waits on the timber until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ripple of the next round.
